entries.7310e669acbc4004: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, against the backdrop of expanded orders from European and American clients, orders received in the non-clinical business reached a record high, and the year-end order backlog also reached record levels. On the other hand, because completion of several large-scale studies for which revenue recognition had been expected shifted to the following period, CRO business revenue fell below the previous year, and losses continued in the translational research business, which records expenses for preparing the commercialization of a nasal migraine treatment drug. Going forward, the company is advancing measures to strengthen its structure for capturing orders from Europe and the United States, including construction of the “EU Laboratory Building,” an NHP experimental facility specialized in large breeding cages for European and American clients, targeted for completion in November 2027.

Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥31,204 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue. Non-clinical studies are conducted at the Safety Research Institute in Kagoshima, Shin Nippon Kagaku Inari Research Center Co., Ltd. in Nagano, the Drug Metabolism Analysis Center in Wakayama and other facilities, and the clinical business is handled by Shin Nippon Kagaku PPD Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate.

entries.8fd4f32e6e90e8c5: A major feature is that the company has built a system within its own group for breeding and supplying experimental NHPs (monkeys), and as a CRO it is positioned as the only such system in the world. In addition to bases in Cambodia and China, the company has strengthened its breeding system in Japan, and because it has a quarantine facility on its own premises designated by the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, it can reliably carry out NHP studies, for which demand is rising in the development of novel drug modalities, within short lead times. Having built bioanalysis (concentration analysis of test substances and the like in biological samples) evaluation systems from an early stage has also led to expanded orders from European and American clients.
